question: Q-N-M1-D4
text: Among Manhattan pickup zones, the 10 with the most distinct OD pairs in 2024.
interpretation: Among Manhattan pickup zones, the 10 with the most distinct OD pairs in 2024 (ties: location id).
assemble: WITH ranked AS (SELECT q.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_od_pairs DESC, pu_location_id) AS rank_no FROM q WHERE trips > 0) SELECT rank_no, pu_location_id, zone, distinct_od_pairs FROM ranked WHERE rank_no <= 10 ORDER BY rank_no
